remarks:
Welcome to 538 23rd Street, a charming brick home filled with character, warmth, and plenty of space to make your own. From the moment you arrive, the classic brick exterior and inviting enclosed front porch set the tone for what’s inside.

Step through the front door to find beautiful hardwood floors, a spacious living room and a formal dining area that flows naturally into the kitchen, creating a comfortable layout for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers abundant wood cabinetry, generous counter space, and a large center peninsula with additional seating.

Throughout the home, you’ll find unique architectural details that give this property its own personality. Upstairs, exposed wood beams, hardwood flooring and spacious bedrooms create a warm and inviting feel that you simply don’t find in every home.

The lower level provides additional usable space for storage, a workshop, recreation area or whatever fits your needs. Outside, enjoy a private backyard with mature landscaping, plenty of green space and a detached garage for additional parking and storage.

Conveniently located in the heart of Niagara Falls with easy access to shopping, dining, schools and local attractions, 538 23rd Street offers a great combination of space, character and value. Whether you’re searching for your next home or a strong addition to your investment portfolio, this is one you’ll want to see in person.
